verdict.rationale: Insomnia (Kong's client tool) explicitly supports gRPC requests and REST via OpenAPI/Postman import, and Kong Gateway/AI Gateway route LLM and MCP traffic, but there's no direct evidence of native GraphQL request support, WebSocket, or SSE handling in either Kong Gateway or Insomnia. missing for 10: explicit GraphQL request support, WebSocket support, SSE support, and independent confirmation of these protocols working end-to-end.
